claims.claim_text: 論文稽核了 Terminal-Bench 2.0，指出約 30% 的題目有問題，修正後釋出 2.1 版。
claims.evidence: Our audit identifies issues in roughly 30% of the benchmark, and we release the resulting repairs as Terminal-Bench 2.1.
claims.note: arXiv abstract read from local raw copy (tb.txt).

claims.claim_text: 修完後準確率上升超過 10 個百分點
claims.evidence: accuracy increased by over 10 percentage points and leaderboard positions move by up to three ranks
claims.note: Lede states it without 平均, matching the source.

claims.claim_text: 修完之後準確率平均上升超過 10 個百分點
claims.evidence: accuracy increased by over 10 percentage points
claims.note: The abstract never says the 10pp is an average; the headline adds 平均, which the source does not state. Unsupported qualifier in the title.

claims.claim_text: 排行榜名次最多移動三名，整體排序仍高度一致（Spearman rho 0.958）
claims.evidence: leaderboard positions move by up to three ranks, even as the overall ranking remains highly correlated (Spearman rho = 0.958)

claims.claim_text: 文章指出 CLAUDE.md、Anthropic 的 memory tool 與 Copilot Memory 存的形狀互不相容，彼此讀不到。
claims.evidence: none of them can read the others (listing AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, Anthropic's memory tool writing to /memories, and Copilot keeping facts about each repo on GitHub's side)
claims.note: Source fetched through WebFetch summary, so quote is near-verbatim rather than confirmed verbatim. Proposal elements (shared data model, versioned registry, MCP operations, examples-illustrative-only, prompt-injection channel) all appear in the summary at stated strength.

claims.claim_text: Mitchell Hashimoto 宣布 1.0 代表函式庫本身與 C ABI 都已穩定。 ... 文中提到 JetBrains IDE 的終端機已跑在 libghostty 上
claims.evidence: The 1.0 release means both the library itself and the C ABI are now stable. ... the terminal in JetBrains IDEs now runs on libghostty.
claims.note: Raw text copy (gh2.txt). Author's own announcement, single primary source.

claims.claim_text: Neovim 則有一個已核准、等待正式標籤的 PR 要用 libghostty-vt 取代 libvterm
claims.evidence: Neovim has an approved pull request replacing libvterm with libghostty-vt. ... The maintainers are waiting on a tagged release before merging

claims.claim_text: 用 libabigail 對照已提交的基準檢查每次變更；ELF 平台上每個匯出符號也有版本
claims.evidence: Every change is checked with libabigail against a committed baseline on Linux, and against golden type manifests on macOS and WebAssembly. On ELF platforms, every exported symbol is also versioned
claims.note: Source scopes libabigail to Linux (other platforms use golden manifests); lede omits that scope. Minor, not meaning-changing.

claims.claim_text: 本期 macaudio 與 AVD 驅動送上了郵件列表，兩者加上 Devicetree 的變更約 13000 行。
claims.evidence: The driver and Devicetree changes represent a hefty chunk of our total patchset, about 3100 lines. ... the AVD driver and related Devicetree changes are around 13000 lines of code.
claims.note: Number misattributed: ~13000 lines is AVD plus its related Devicetree alone; macaudio plus its Devicetree is ~3100 lines. The lede merges them into one 13000 figure.

claims.claim_text: M3 機型的支援現在不用 EXPERT 旗標
claims.evidence: so M3 support is now generally available without the EXPERT flag!
claims.note: Raw text copy (asahi.txt).

claims.claim_text: Thunderbolt 目前只支援 USB3、XDomain 與 Thunderbolt Networking，PCIe 與 DisplayPort 通道仍缺。
claims.evidence: Currently, only USB3, XDomain and Thunderbolt Networking are supported. ... PCIe and DisplayPort tunnelling — required for most Thunderbolt docks — are not supported. Yet.

claims.claim_text: 另一條線是在 16 KiB 頁面的核心上讓單一行程使用 4 KiB 頁面，讓幾款遊戲不必經過 muvm 就能跑。
claims.evidence: Their addition to the Android kernel is called P3S, or Per Process Page Size. ... Star Wars Battlefront (2004) running outside of muvm ... Fallout: New Vegas (2010) running outside of muvm
claims.note: Supported as an experiment, but the lede does not say the patchset is Google's Android work and that Asahi explicitly will NOT ship it downstream ('we do not want to ship this in our downstream tree'). Optional clarification; not a factual error.

claims.claim_text: GitHub 說已展示 5,000 個 agent 同時對單一 repo 推送，以及每秒 7,200 次推送。
claims.evidence: Through internal testing, we've demonstrated the ability to support 5,000 concurrent agents working on a repository, sending 7,200 pushes per second to a repo
claims.note: Raw text copy (gh.txt). Lede attributes it to GitHub's own claim ('GitHub 說'), which matches internal-testing provenance.

claims.claim_text: 架構把 packs 與索引放在 Azure Blob Storage，參照與 pack 清單交給以 compare-and-swap 提交的 Ref-CAS，寫入時先上傳 pack 再提交參照交易。
claims.evidence: References and the list of packs that make up the repository (the pack manifest) live in a separate replicated log service we call Ref-CAS (for "Reference Compare-and-Swap"). ... A virtual replica uploads a push's pack to Blob Storage before it commits the reference transaction.
claims.note: Also supports the lede-of-the-day thread sentence about Ref-CAS.

claims.claim_text: 目前為有限的私人預覽，更廣的推出預計在明年初。
claims.evidence: It's available in a limited private preview now, with a broader rollout early next year.
claims.note: Volatile; source dated 2026-11-05, fresh.

claims.claim_text: Unix 上密碼雜湊為 "*" 代表帳號鎖定，而 musl 的 crypt 自 2012 年起，對過長而無法雜湊的密碼也回傳 "*"。
claims.evidence: Since 2012, musl libc's `crypt` function has returned the string "*" for a password that's too long for it to hash. ... On Unix, a password hash of "*" has meant a locked account since the very early days.
claims.note: Via WebFetch summary (near-verbatim). Also supports the no-PAM OpenSSH vulnerability and 'not a memory safety vulnerability' statements.

claims.claim_text: 他的論點是 Rust 社群的慣例不容許這種帶內哨兵值，所以同樣的介面在 Rust 裡多半會回傳錯誤變體。
claims.evidence: the norms of the Rust community do not allow that ... a password that's too long would be returned as an error variant
claims.note: Via WebFetch summary. Source also concedes Rust code could still return "*"; lede's 多半 captures that.

claims.claim_text: 作者把 DNS 從 Route 53 搬到 Bunny DNS，CDN 從 CloudFront 搬到 Bunny CDN，月費從 5 美元降到 1 美元。
claims.evidence: The bill went from US$5 per month to US$1.
claims.note: Via WebFetch summary (near-verbatim).

claims.claim_text: 若第二近的距離至少是最近者的兩倍且多出 1,000 英里以上，就只回傳最近的一台。
claims.evidence: If the second one is at twice the distance and at more than 1000 miles [from the first]
claims.note: Fetched wording is 'at more than 1000 miles', not 'an extra 1000 miles beyond'. The lede's 多出 1,000 英里以上 (1000 miles farther) is a different reading and is not confirmed; threshold semantics (absolute 1000 miles vs +1000 miles) is ambiguous in the fetched text. Also source mentions a 2-minute TTL in that case, not in lede (fine). Re-read exact sentence before publishing; fall back to source wording.

claims.claim_text: Bunny 會對每個查詢執行使用者寫的 JavaScript，腳本從七台 NixOS VM 回傳最近的兩台
claims.evidence: The blog is hosted on seven small NixOS machines in different regions worldwide. ... Each answer returns the addresses of the two nearest live servers
claims.note: Via WebFetch summary. Performance caveat (comparable to AWS, 'I need a bit more time to gather more data') also matches the lede's hedge.

claims.claim_text: 所有代理流量的 zone 皆已正式提供
claims.evidence: Full transaction detection is generally available for all zones proxying traffic through Cloudflare.
claims.note: Via WebFetch summary. Request+response evaluation, metadata, and block-before-requester behaviour also appear in the summary at stated strength; source says block page 'and' HTTP 403 where lede says 或 (trivial).

claims.claim_text: Free 方案也能建立最多三條自訂回應規則，回應本文規則則尚未支援。
claims.evidence: All customers can create up to three custom response rules. ... Creating rules on the response body is not yet available.
claims.note: Free plan inclusion follows from 'All customers'; the fetch summary did not show a Free-specific sentence. Acceptable inference-by-generalisation.

claims.claim_text: Meridian 用 Servo 負責網頁渲染與瀏覽器狀態，介面則由 Zed 編輯器背後的 GPUI 繪製，兩者靠 gpui-servo 連接。
claims.evidence: Web pages and browser state is managed by Servo. ... The browser's chrome is drawn by gpui, the UI framework behind the Zed editor.
claims.note: Via WebFetch summary. Source names the glue library gpui-servo only in the summary parenthetical; fine. Feature list matches.

claims.claim_text: 專案自稱仍是實驗，在 JavaScript 與版面配置較輕的網站上效果最好。
claims.evidence: Meridian is an experiment and a work in progress. ... already useful for sites with "light on javascript and layouting features"
claims.note: Source says it is already useful on light sites; it does not say it works 'best' there (a superlative). Hedge inflated from 'useful' to '效果最好'.

claims.claim_text: 作者指出 Deno 的權限提示就是等待 stdin 輸入的 stdout 文字，惡意程式可用終端機跳脫碼動手腳。
claims.evidence: using an attacker-controlled channel for security-sensitive information (prompt is plain text written to stdout and read from stdin; terminal control sequences are in-band)
claims.note: Via WebFetch summary, so verbatim confirmation is imperfect.

claims.claim_text: 以名稱授權的 --allow-run=uname 也能被子行程設定的 PATH 繞過，而 Deno 對 LD_PRELOAD 的處置是封鎖以 LD_ 開頭的環境變數。作者的結論是 Deno 行程並非真正的沙箱，只是假裝是。
claims.evidence: disallowing to set environment variables starting with `LD_` ... Deno process is not actually sandboxed, it only pretends it is.
claims.note: Via WebFetch summary. Source adds that the LD_ block addresses only that specific case; lede does not contradict this.

claims.claim_text: Terminal-Bench 被稽核出約 30% 的題目有問題，agent 記憶各家存各的格式，Deno 的權限提示只是 stdout 上的文字，musl 的 crypt 則用 "*" 這個哨兵值同時代表錯誤與鎖定帳號
claims.evidence: roughly 30% of the benchmark; none of them can read the others; prompt is plain text written to stdout; "*" returned for a password too long to hash and also means a locked account
claims.note: Thread sentence restates items #03/#08/#10/#01 claims already verified above (c01, c05, c25, c16); the interpretive frame (unwritten convention) is the author's synthesis, not a factual claim. Same-origin restatement, counted as single-source.
